question: The term pisciculture is related with:
solution:
The correct answer is __**fish farming**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Pisciculture refers to the breeding, rearing, and transplantation of fish by artificial means.
 
• It is a branch of aquaculture, specifically focusing on the cultivation of fish in controlled environments.
 
• This practice is used to increase fish production for commercial purposes.
 
• Common species cultivated through pisciculture include carp, catfish, tilapia, and salmon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Aquaculture**

 
 
• Aquaculture is the farming of aquatic organisms such as fish, crustaceans, mollusks, and aquatic plants.
 
• It encompasses the breeding, rearing, and harvesting of these organisms in various water environments, including ponds, rivers, lakes, and the ocean.
 
 
 
• **Mariculture**
 
 
• Mariculture is a specialized branch of aquaculture involving the cultivation of marine organisms in the open ocean or in enclosed sections of the ocean.
 
• It includes the farming of species such as oysters, clams, mussels, and seaweed.
 
 
 
• **Inland Fisheries**
 
 
• Inland fisheries focus on the cultivation and harvesting of fish in freshwater environments like rivers, lakes, and ponds.
 
• This practice is vital for enhancing fish production in non-coastal areas.
 
 
 
• **Fish Hatcheries**
 
 
• Fish hatcheries are facilities where fish are bred, hatched, and reared through the early stages of life.
 
• They play a crucial role in supporting fisheries by providing a consistent supply of juvenile fish for stocking purposes.
